lines.text: On the third day, Esther stood in the inner court, and the king held out the gold scepter to her.
The king offered Esther up to half the kingdom, and she asked him and Haman to come to her banquet today.
At the banquet the king asked again what she wanted, and Esther invited him and Haman to another banquet in three days.
Haman was filled with rage when Mordecai would not rise at the king's gate, and he told his friends he was not satisfied.
Zeresh and his friends told Haman to build a gallows seventy cubits high, and he had it constructed.
